title.zh: 将公共图书馆局更名为国家图书馆的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Bureau of Public Libraries to the National Library
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Bureau of Public Libraries to the National Library

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3873_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Bureau of Public Libraries is hereby changed to that of The National Library.
All references to the Bureau of Public Libraries in laws, executive orders, rules and regulations shall henceforth be understood to refer to The National Library.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1964.
